﻿﻿This mod adds pieces of furniture and craftables for you to build your very own farmer's market in the style of Atelier Wildflour's Crops and Forage! This add on to our [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18814]Farmers Market Core[/url]﻿ set adds plenty of mushrooms, berries, herbs and more for you to decorate your farm.

Dont forget to download the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18814]core mod[/url]﻿ for the essential stall building blocks for you to build the stalls and stands of your dreams!

NEW FOR 1.6 - recolors available via config! Choose from Classic, Light or Dark
